lessons.title: Reading About Christmas Traditions
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to retrieve facts about a Christmas tradition from a different country.
success_criteria: I can name a country's Christmas tradition.
I can say one fact about it.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss the children's own Christmas/winter traditions.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Read a simple text about a Christmas tradition from another country (e.g. Sweden's St Lucia, Australia's beach Christmas).
lessons.independent_task: Children answer retrieval questions about the tradition read.
key_questions: What country is this tradition from?

differentiation.greater_depth: Answer in full sentences with detail

lessons.assessment_notes: Note retrieval skill applied to a cultural/geographical text — evidence for ENG.R2/GEOG.2.
lessons.home_link: Ask your family about a Christmas/winter tradition they know of.

lessons.title: Advent Countdown: Counting Down
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to count backwards from 20 confidently.
success_criteria: I can count backwards from 20.
I can say what number comes next when counting back.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss advent calendars and counting down to Christmas.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model counting backwards from 20, linking to an advent countdown.
lessons.independent_task: Children practise counting backwards from 20 and complete a countdown number sequence activity.
key_questions: What comes after 15 when counting backwards?
lessons.assessment_notes: Record backward counting fluency — evidence for MATHS.N1.
lessons.home_link: Practise counting backwards from 20 together.

lessons.title: Christmas in Hot and Cold Countries
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to compare how Christmas is celebrated in a hot country vs a cold country.
success_criteria: I can name a difference between a hot and cold Christmas.
I can say why the weather affects celebrations.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss that not all countries have a cold, snowy Christmas.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Compare Christmas in a cold country (UK, Finland) to a hot country (Australia), discussing how weather affects traditions (BBQ vs roast dinner, beach vs snow).
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a comparison chart for hot vs cold Christmas celebrations.
key_questions: What is different about a hot Christmas?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note comparative geographical reasoning — evidence for GEOG.2.
lessons.plenary: Recap hot vs cold Christmas differences.
lessons.home_link: Imagine and describe a Christmas in a hot country.

lessons.title: Christmas Decorations from Around the World
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to create a decoration inspired by a different country's tradition.
success_criteria: I can create a decoration.
I can say which country inspired it.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at examples of Christmas decorations from different countries.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model creating a simple decoration inspired by a tradition studied (e.g. a Scandinavian straw ornament style).
lessons.independent_task: Children create their own decoration inspired by a country's tradition.

differentiation.greater_depth: Research and replicate a specific traditional style

lessons.assessment_notes: Observe cultural inspiration applied to art — evidence for ART.1/ART.2/GEOG.2.
lessons.home_link: Make a decoration inspired by a tradition at home.

lessons.title: Writing About a Christmas Tradition
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to write sentences describing a Christmas tradition from another country.
success_criteria: I can name the country.
I can write a sentence about their tradition.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap Monday's tradition reading.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model writing a sentence describing a tradition from another country.
lessons.independent_task: Children write 2-3 sentences about a Christmas tradition from a country they've learned about.
key_questions: What country are you writing about?
What do they do to celebrate?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note descriptive/factual writing progress — evidence for ENG.W2/W3.
lessons.home_link: Tell your family about a Christmas tradition from another country.

lessons.title: Christmas Shopping: Using Coins
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to recognise coins and find totals for simple items.
success_criteria: I can recognise 1p, 2p, 5p, 10p coins.
I can add coins to find a total.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap counting in small steps.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model recognising coins and adding them to find a total for a pretend Christmas gift.
lessons.independent_task: Children practise recognising coins and finding totals for pretend shopping items using play money.
key_questions: How much do these coins make altogether?

differentiation.greater_depth: Use a range of coins to make amounts up to 20p+

lessons.assessment_notes: Record coin recognition and simple addition of money — evidence for MATHS.MEA.
lessons.home_link: Practise recognising coins at home with real or play money.

lessons.title: Locating Christmas Countries on a World Map
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to locate countries studied on a simple world map.
success_criteria: I can find a country on a world map.
I can point to a continent.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap countries discussed this week.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model locating the countries studied (e.g. Sweden, Australia) on a simple world map.
lessons.independent_task: Children locate and mark the countries studied on their own world map outline.

differentiation.support: Adult points to location for child to mark
differentiation.greater_depth: Locate 3+ countries and name their continents

lessons.assessment_notes: Note locational knowledge development — evidence for GEOG.1.
lessons.plenary: Recap locations found on the world map.
lessons.home_link: Find a country on a map or globe at home.

lessons.title: Christmas Card Design
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to design and make a Christmas card using a chosen technique.
success_criteria: I can design a card.
I can use a technique learned this term (printing, collage, drawing).
lessons.starter_activity: Recap art techniques learned this term.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model designing a simple Christmas card using a chosen technique.
lessons.independent_task: Children design and make their own Christmas card.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note application of techniques learned this term — evidence for ART.1.
lessons.home_link: Give your card to the person it's for.

lessons.title: Phonics: Reading Christmas-Themed Words
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read Christmas-themed words.
success_criteria: I can blend and read Christmas words.
I can read a festive sentence.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap graphemes practised this term.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Introduce/reinforce a grapheme, blending Christmas-themed words.
lessons.independent_task: Children read themed word and sentence cards.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note phonics application — evidence for ENG.R1.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate reading progress with a themed reading game.
lessons.home_link: Practise reading Christmas words over the week.

lessons.title: Wrapping Presents: Measuring and Shapes
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply measuring and shape knowledge to a wrapping context.
success_criteria: I can estimate and measure paper needed.
I can identify the shape of a present box.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss wrapping a present shape (cuboid box).
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model estimating and measuring paper needed to wrap a box, discussing its 3D shape.
lessons.independent_task: Children estimate then measure paper for wrapping a box shape, identifying its properties.
key_questions: How much paper do you think you'll need?

differentiation.greater_depth: Compare estimate to actual measurement and explain difference

lessons.assessment_notes: Note applied measurement and shape knowledge — evidence for MATHS.MEA/GEO.
lessons.plenary: Recap wrapping shape and measuring experience.
lessons.home_link: Help wrap a present at home if appropriate.

lessons.title: Christmas Foods Around the World
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe a Christmas food eaten in a different country.
success_criteria: I can name a Christmas food from another country.
I can compare it to a food my family eats.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss foods children's families eat at Christmas/winter celebrations.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Introduce Christmas foods from different countries (e.g. KFC in Japan, tamales in Mexico, if age-appropriate and allergy-safe to discuss only).
lessons.independent_task: Children draw and label a Christmas food from another country, comparing to their own.
key_questions: Is it similar to what your family eats?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note cultural comparison skill — evidence for GEOG.2.
lessons.home_link: Talk about your family's favourite winter celebration food.

lessons.title: Making a Christmas Decoration for the Classroom
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to create a decoration to contribute to the classroom display.
success_criteria: I can make a festive decoration.
I can contribute it to the class display.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss ideas for classroom decorations.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model making a simple paper decoration (chain, star, snowflake).
lessons.independent_task: Children make their own decoration for the classroom display.
key_questions: Where will it go in the display?
lessons.assessment_notes: Observe fine motor and creative contribution — evidence for ART.1.
lessons.plenary: Put up decorations together as a class.
lessons.home_link: Make a decoration for your home.

lessons.title: Sharing Traditions Circle Time
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to share information about their own family's traditions clearly.
success_criteria: I can share a family tradition.
I can listen to a friend's tradition.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the range of traditions studied this week.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model sharing a tradition clearly and respectfully listening to others.
lessons.independent_task: Children share their own family's winter/Christmas tradition in a circle time discussion.
key_questions: What does your family do to celebrate?
What did you learn from a friend's tradition?

differentiation.greater_depth: Ask a respectful follow-up question to a peer

lessons.assessment_notes: Note spoken language and respectful listening — evidence for ENG.SL1.
lessons.plenary: Recap the variety of traditions shared.
lessons.home_link: Share what you learned about other families' traditions.

lessons.title: Sharing Presents: Halves and Quarters Recap
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply finding halves and quarters to a present-sharing context.
success_criteria: I can find half of a group of presents.
I can find a quarter of a group of presents.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap halves and quarters from Week 5.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model finding half/quarter of a set of pretend presents.
lessons.independent_task: Children solve half/quarter problems using present-counters.
key_questions: What is half of these presents?

differentiation.greater_depth: Solve without counters and explain reasoning

lessons.assessment_notes: Record fraction fluency recap — evidence for MATHS.N4.
lessons.home_link: Practise finding halves and quarters with any small objects.

lessons.title: Christmas Around the World: Recap Map
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to summarise Christmas traditions from countries studied this week using a world map.
success_criteria: I can point to a country and say its tradition.
I can compare two countries' traditions.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all countries and traditions studied this week.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss synthesising the week's learning onto a class world map display.
lessons.independent_task: Children add their country fact/tradition to the class 'Christmas Around the World' map.

differentiation.support: Adult supports placement and fact recall

lessons.assessment_notes: Note synthesis of the week's cultural geography learning — evidence for GEOG.2/GEOG.1.
lessons.plenary: Recap the completed class world map.
lessons.home_link: Show the class world map project to your family if possible (photo/description).

lessons.title: Christmas Performance Craft/Costume
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to create a simple prop or costume element for the Christmas performance.
success_criteria: I can make a simple prop/costume piece.
I can explain its role in the performance.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss the upcoming Christmas performance.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model making a simple prop or costume piece needed for the performance.
lessons.independent_task: Children make their own prop/costume piece for the performance.
resources_needed: Craft materials as needed for the performance
key_questions: How will you use it in the performance?
lessons.assessment_notes: Observe craft skill applied to a performance purpose — evidence for ART.1.
lessons.home_link: Practise your part of the performance at home.

lessons.title: Christmas Around the World Quiz
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to answer comprehension questions about Christmas traditions learned this week.
success_criteria: I can answer a question about a tradition.
I can compare two traditions.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the week's key vocabulary.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Quiz-style recap covering traditions, countries, and foods studied.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a review worksheet/quiz.
lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension and cultural knowledge recall — evidence for ENG.R2/GEOG.2.
lessons.home_link: Share what you learned about Christmas around the world with your family.

lessons.title: Maths Review: Money, Measuring, Fractions
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply money, measuring, and fraction skills learned this week.
success_criteria: I can recognise coins.
I can measure using a ruler.
I can find halves/quarters.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the week's maths vocabulary.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Quick recap of coin recognition, measuring, and fractions.
lessons.independent_task: Children rotate through 3 stations covering each skill.
lessons.assessment_notes: Summarise week 13 maths observations for each child — evidence for MATHS.MEA/N4.
lessons.plenary: Class recap game combining all three skills.
lessons.home_link: Continue practising this week's maths skills over the holidays.

lessons.title: Christmas Around the World: Final Recap Display
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to summarise key facts about Christmas traditions worldwide learned this week.
success_criteria: I can name a tradition and its country.
I can say what I found most interesting.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the whole week's geography and cultural learning.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss finalising the class 'Christmas Around the World' display.
lessons.independent_task: Children help finalise the class display with all contributions from the week.
key_questions: What have we learned about Christmas worldwide?
What was your favourite tradition learned?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note synthesis of the week's cultural geography learning — evidence for GEOG.2/GEOG.1.
lessons.home_link: Share your favourite Christmas tradition learned this week with your family.

lessons.title: Christmas Art Celebration
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to showcase their Christmas-themed art from the week.
success_criteria: I can show my favourite piece.
I can explain the technique used.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap all art created this week (decorations, cards, performance props).
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss showcasing Christmas-themed art progress.
lessons.independent_task: Children showcase their favourite Christmas art piece to the class.

differentiation.support: Point to work and name the technique
differentiation.greater_depth: Explain the process and cultural inspiration behind it

lessons.assessment_notes: Note reflective language and technique recall — evidence for ART.1/ART.2.
lessons.home_link: Show your favourite Christmas art piece to your family.
